name: @jit-studyhub/kiosk
description: Desktop QR check-in kiosk for Just In Time Study Hub

scripts.start: npm run embed-config && node scripts/install-linux-desktop-entry.cjs && electron .
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run embed-config && node scripts/install-linux-desktop-entry.cjs && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run embed-config && electron-builder --projectDir electron
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run embed-config && electron-builder --projectDir electron --win nsis
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run embed-config && electron-builder --projectDir electron --linux AppImage
